primary_task: Generate or edit a raster image (photo, illustration, mockup, cutout) for the project with the built-in image_gen tool and save it into the workspace.

requirements.name: built-in image_gen tool
requirements.evidence: '**Default built-in tool mode (preferred):** built-in `image_gen` tool for normal image generation and editing.' and 'Use the built-in `image_gen` tool by default for all normal image generation and editing requests.'
requirements.basis: The tools list has no image generation tool; lacks: 'connectors or integrations other than the tools listed'.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY (fallback CLI mode)
requirements.evidence: '**Fallback CLI mode (explicit-only):** `scripts/image_gen.py` CLI. Use only when the user explicitly asks for the CLI path. Requires `OPENAI_API_KEY`.' and 'Never switch to CLI fallback automatically.'
requirements.basis: lacks: 'accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub'.

requirements.name: OpenAI Images API host (fallback CLI)
requirements.evidence: '`OPENAI_API_KEY` must be set for live API calls.'
requirements.basis: 'other hosts are refused' (only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open).

requirements.name: openai / pillow python packages (uv pip)
requirements.evidence: 'uv pip install openai'; 'Optional for downscaling only: uv pip install pillow'
requirements.basis: bash: 'install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI ...)'.

notes: Reading taken: the built-in tool is the only default path and the CLI is explicit-only; both routes are unavailable here anyway (no image_gen tool; no OpenAI key or host). Other reading: if the user explicitly asks for the CLI, it still needs OPENAI_API_KEY and an OpenAI host, so the verdict would still be BLOCKED. Only a non-raster SVG/HTML placeholder could be produced, which the document discourages unless vector output is requested.
